title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 14:00 UTC on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日 14:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 14:00 UTC on 23 September. The 14:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 14:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 0.67/1M). Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-23 13:52 UTC; label 1M; last-180 window from 12:30 UTC). Published-window maximum is 1.00 (first at 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC; label 1Z). Window start 2026-09-23 09:32 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 15:00 UTC hour is still incomplete (30 samples through 15:29) and is not used as the main card.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.33（0P），取樣 2026-09-23 14:00 UTC。14:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 14:59，時段初 0.33／0P、時段末 0.67／1M）。近 180 筆最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-23 13:52 UTC；標籤 1M；近 180 筆窗自 12:30 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.00（最先見於 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC；標籤 1Z）。窗起點 2026-09-23 09:32 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。15:00 UTC 時段尚未收滿（至 15:29 僅 30 筆），不作為主卡片。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (14:00 UTC on 23 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 14:00 UTC is 0.33/0P; the hour ends 0.67/1M at 14:59. A 1.00/1Z sample remains in the published window at 2026-09-23 11:42 UTC.

title.en: A magnitude 4.6 earthquake occurred south of the Fiji Islands on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日，斐濟群島以南發生規模 4.6 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.6, depth about 528 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.7 (us6000tx3m, 180 km NW of Hihifo, Tonga).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.6，深度約 528 公里。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.7（us6000tx3m，東加 Hihifo 西北約 180 公里）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
